title: Bazine Netal
description: A feared and notorious bounty hunter, Bazine Netal boasts a baffleweave dress that can jam sensors and keep her hidden to find her quarry. Growing up on the planet Chaaktil, she learned deadly martial arts skills at the combat school of Delphi Kloda. Skulking around Maz Kanata's castle, she was able to report the appearance of Finn and Rey to the First Order when they arrived with Han Solo.
